payload.artist_html: Drawing by Michael Long, published by Christine M. Janis, Borja Figueirido, Larisa DeSantis, Stephan Lautenschlager
payload.description_html: Charitomenosuchus leedsi (Andrews, 1913), comb. nov., NHMUK PV R 3320, holotype. Skull in (A) dorsal, (B) ventral (palatal) and (C) right lateral views; partial mandible in (D) dorsal view. (E) Posterior section of the mandible in right lateral view; atlas in (F) anterior and (G) right lateral view. Refer to abbreviations list. Scale bars: 10 cm (A–D) and 2 cm (E–G).
